---
title: "PCA"
format: html
---

```{r}
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
dat_avg <- readRDS("../data/data_aug.rds")
```

## Make wide for PCA

```{r}
dat_avg_wide <- dat_avg |>   
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(title,geo_accession, mouse, timepoint, tissue),
              names_from  = ENTREZ_ID,
              values_from = expression
              )
```

## PCA for all organs

```{r}
expr_mat <- dat_avg_wide |>
  dplyr::select(-title, -geo_accession, -mouse, -timepoint, -tissue) |>
  as.matrix()

rownames(expr_mat) <- dat_avg_wide$title   # or geo_accession

pca <- prcomp(expr_mat, scale. = TRUE)

plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2])

pca.var <- pca$sdev^2
pca.var.per <- round(pca.var/sum(pca.var)*100, 1)
pca.var.per
barplot(pca.var.per, main="Scree Plot", xlab="Principal Component",
        ylab="Percent variation")


```

#### Make ggplot PCA 1 and 2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca$x),
                       X=pca$x[,1],
                       Y=pca$x[,2],
                       tissue = dat_avg_wide$tissue,
                       time = dat_avg_wide$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data, aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=tissue, shape=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC1 - ", pca.var.per[1], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC2 - ", pca.var.per[2], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My PCA graph")
```

#### Make ggplot PCA 1 and 3

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca$x),
                       X=pca$x[,1],
                       Y=pca$x[,3],
                       tissue = dat_avg_wide$tissue,
                       time = dat_avg_wide$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data, aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=tissue, shape=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC1 - ", pca.var.per[1], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC3 - ", pca.var.per[3], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My PCA graph")
```

#### Make ggplot PCA 2 and 3

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca$x),
                       X=pca$x[,2],
                       Y=pca$x[,3],
                       tissue = dat_avg_wide$tissue,
                       time = dat_avg_wide$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data, aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=tissue, shape=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC2 - ", pca.var.per[2], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC3 - ", pca.var.per[3], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My PCA graph")
```

### Check loading scores for PC1of all organs

```{r}
loading_scores <- pca$rotation[,1]
gene_scores <- abs(loading_scores)
gene_scores_ranked <- sort(gene_scores, decreasing = TRUE)
top_10_genes <- names(gene_scores_ranked[1:10])
top_10_genes
pca$rotation[top_10_genes,1]
```

## Per organ PCA

### PCA for brain

```{r}
dat_brain <- dat_avg_wide |>
  filter(tissue == "brain")

expr_mat_brain <- dat_brain |>
  dplyr::select(-title, -geo_accession, -mouse, -timepoint, -tissue) |>
  as.matrix()

rownames(expr_mat_brain) <- dat_brain$title   # or geo_accession

pca_brain <- prcomp(expr_mat_brain, scale. = TRUE)

plot(pca_brain$x[,1], pca_brain$x[,2])

brain.pca.var <- pca_brain$sdev^2
brain.pca.var.per <- round(brain.pca.var/sum(brain.pca.var)*100, 1)
brain.pca.var.per
barplot(brain.pca.var.per, main="Scree Plot Brain", xlab="Principal Component",
        ylab="Percent variation")



```

#### ggplot brain

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca.data.brain <- data.frame(Sample=rownames(pca_brain$x),
                       X=pca_brain$x[,1],
                       Y=pca_brain$x[,2],
                       time = dat_brain$timepoint)
ggplot(data=pca.data.brain, aes(X, Y, label=Sample, color=time)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab(paste("PC1 - ", brain.pca.var.per[1], "%", sep="")) + 
  ylab(paste("PC2 - ", brain.pca.var.per[2], "%", sep="")) +
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("My Brain PCA graph")
```

#### Check loading scores for PC1of brain

```{r}
loading_scores_brain <- pca_brain$rotation[,1]
gene_scores_brain <- abs(loading_scores_brain)
gene_scores_ranked_brain <- sort(gene_scores_brain, decreasing = TRUE)
top_10_genes_brain <- names(gene_scores_ranked_brain[1:10])
top_10_genes_brain
pca_brain$rotation[top_10_genes_brain,1]
```
